title: DIVINE REFUGE
STRENGTH IN TROUBLE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: light rays breaking through dark clouds

scenes.a: If the weight of this uncertainty is pressing against your heart, stay for this quiet moment.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
Lord, anchor my soul in these eternal words as the ground shifts beneath my weary feet.
Let your peace encompass my mind, shielding me from the storms that seek to distract me.
Keep me under the shadow of your wings, trusting that you are my constant, unwavering fortress.
